action.objective: Convert with a6a7, escorting the passed pawn to promotion while keeping the rook and bishop active and king safe.
action.rationale: a6a7 is the only commit-ready move: exact depth-4 verification at 962 with no Black mate-in-one and tactical_refutation not_found. The a-pawn threatens a8=Q; Rxa7 is not available since the Black rook on f7 cannot reach a7 in one move, and our bishop covers the queening path. The broad search also rated a6a7 highest (1008). No risk acceptance needed.
